title: @here collective ask in a people group: both agents answer once, nobody answers twice

turns.prompt: hey agents — each of you, in one line: what is your name and what is 6 × 7?

rubric.criteria: Both agents (lane-a and lane-b) answered once each, each giving its own name and 42. A bare name prefix counts as stating the name ("lane-a, 6 × 7 = 42." is a full pass); neither answered for the other or twice; no agent asked which one was meant.

regression: collective address in a project group (the respond judge's `all agents` verdict, responders.rs); run 12: judge read 'lane-a, 6 × 7 = 42.' as no name — rubric wording fixed, re-graded PASS
